verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents follow-up or action items from incidents or retrospectives, tracking them to completion, or syncing them bidirectionally to an issue tracker. The closest items are adjacent features that earn no credit here: runbook automation that creates incident Jira tickets (firehydrant-docs-2) and a default runbook step called 'Add Task List' (firehydrant-docs-41).

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker
